title: Web group money journeys: browser E2E (backlog A1)

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Browser tests drive, through the web UI, adding members and adding group expenses with each split type, an invalid split, multiple payers, and group capture from the dashboard.
Browser tests drive edit, delete, delete-undo, comment, settle-my-share, move-to-group and custom settlement through the web UI.
Every money change is verified against the server's stored payers, shares, balances or settlements, exact to the cent.
Tests use no new logins or registrations and run only against a local isolated stack.
